title: Failure ownership
summary: A failing or flaky test is a defect. Fix it here, commit and re-run the gate, even if this item didn't cause it. For a failure this item didn't cause, agree the next step first with a live steering seat that covers the item. If another live item already fixes that same failure, add an integration dependency on it with fact:merged, send its holder the evidence with yoke say --item and park. If the fix is too large, ask with yoke decision-requests ask. Never file, dash or promote an item yourself. Never weaken a behavior assertion or re-run unchanged inputs to get a pass. Cancelled or never-started jobs are no verdict and remain recoverable. Jobs with failure, startup_failure or cancelled conclusions and no runner or steps reached no verdict. The failed-log report labels them never_started and reads Checks annotations instead of downloading nonexistent logs. Watchers and CI QA preserve annotation levels and messages. A failure annotation asks the operator before any retry and does not spend a no-verdict attempt; without annotations the existing retry remains. A nonzero runner_id proves a job started even with no steps; its missing or expired log stays expired_or_missing.
